parties.respondent: The Bihar Public Service Commission & Ors.

summary: Issue: Cancellation of candidature for non-production of original certificates at interview stage despite submission of self-attested copies and subsequent production of originals. Standard applied: Whether strict non-compliance with procedural requirement warrants disqualification when qualifications and eligibility are not in question. Reasoning: The Court noted that the candidates had scored higher than the last selected in their categories, submitted self-attested copies, and produced originals before the Commission’s 27.11.2019 meeting. No inaccuracy in documents was alleged. The requirement to submit originals was held not to be mandatory for eligibility, particularly as verification occurs later during appointment or probation. Outcome: Impugned judgment of Patna High Court upheld in part; candidatures cancelled solely for technical non-production of originals set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 14 of the Constitution of India
Conditions for Bihar Judicial Services Examination
final_judgment: Leave granted. The cancellation of candidature of the appellants solely on the ground of non-production of original certificates at the time of interview is set aside. The appellants to be considered for appointment based on merit and availability of vacancies, with 5 vacancies reported in General Category.
